name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Compound upper body horizontal press targeting the pectoralis major.
instructions: Lie flat on bench, unrack bar, lower to mid-chest, and press up until arms are extended.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Upper chest pressing movement on an inclined bench.
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells upward in an arc over the clavicles.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description: Foundational lower body compound exercise for quad and hip development.
instructions: Place bar across upper traps, squat down until hips break parallel, drive through mid-foot to stand.

name: Barbell Deadlift
description: Full-body posterior chain pull from the floor.
instructions: Hinge at hips, grip bar outside legs, engage lats, push floor away through heels until standing upright.

name: Overhead Press
description: Vertical pressing movement from front rack to overhead lockout.
instructions: Stand tall with core braced, press bar vertically overhead locking elbows and shoulders.

name: Pull-Up
description: Bodyweight vertical pull targeting the latissimus dorsi.
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip, pull chest toward bar until chin clears, lower with control.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
description: Horizontal pulling exercise for mid and upper back thickness.
instructions: Hinge forward at 45 degrees, pull barbell to lower ribcage keeping elbows tucked, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
description: Isolation exercise for the biceps brachii.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms forward, curl weight toward shoulders without swinging elbows.

name: Tricep Cable Pushdown
description: Isolation exercise for the triceps using a cable stack.
instructions: Grip rope or bar attachment with elbows pinned to ribs, extend arms downward until fully locked out.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip-hinge movement focusing on hamstring eccentric loading and hypertrophy.
instructions: Start from standing, push hips backward with soft knees, lower bar along shins until hamstrings stretch, drive hips forward.

name: Running
description: Continuous aerobic running for cardiovascular endurance and calorie expenditure.
instructions: Maintain upright posture, mid-foot strike, steady cadence, and controlled breathing rhythm.

name: Stationary Cycling
description: Low-impact stationary indoor cycling for aerobic conditioning.
instructions: Adjust saddle height to slight knee flexion at bottom pedal stroke, maintain consistent cadence.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold pushup position on forearms, maintaining rigid straight line from shoulders to ankles.

name: Hamstring Static Stretch
description: Static stretch to increase hamstring flexibility and hip mobility.
instructions: Extend one leg forward on heel, hinge at hips with flat back until a gentle stretch is felt in posterior thigh.
